_note: Danger signs that trigger 'Tell the nurse now' (PR9, RQ4.1). Only from WHO IMCI, WHO PCPNC (maternal danger signs) and Uganda Clinical Guidelines 2023. NEVER add a sign without a source. Sources and status per sign: docs/product/danger-signs.md. 'status': cited = source checked; verify_page = source known, page number still to confirm (shown in the demo with a 'pending page check' label); disabled = no checked source, never loaded. 'verified' is true only for cited entries. 'question' is the English text asked; Luganda text and audio must be written and recorded by a native speaker and clinician-checked (never machine-translated). 'phrasesEn' are English demo phrases for synthetic test clips, taken from the sourced wording; transcript matching may only ADD a flag. 'notSureIsYes': in pregnancy, Not sure raises the flag too.
